owner: City public-health inspection and oversight team
observed_evidence: The 25% exploration policy allocated 960 slots over 8 quarters. Historical results were observable for 197 selections, giving full-roster critical-finding bounds of 4.9% to 84.4%.
conditional_action: Implement exploration as a recorded randomized sample of the non-targeted eligible roster, retaining each stratum's probability. Evaluate future yield with design weights and geographic coverage.
claim_boundary: In the archival data only inspected restaurants reveal violations. The roster requires a known prior restaurant classification; never-classified premises are outside the target. Later inspections do not identify the causal effect of scheduling earlier.
